name: project-memory
description: Warm-start project folders for agent work. project-init scaffolds CLAUDE.md, memory.md, lessons.md and pm-reflect's own pending-lessons.md and lesson-log.md, and interviews you for context; compound-learning records what happened in each session; pm-reflect is the lesson engine - it tracks evidence, promotes a pattern to a binding lesson once it recurs across sessions, expires ones that go stale, and reviews all the files for anything else that needs pruning, with your approval.
